name: ThermalDesk
tagline: ESC/POS thermal receipt printing, without the driver headaches
description: ThermalDesk turns your phone into a complete thermal printing station for shops, restaurants, medical stores and warehouses. Connect over Bluetooth to any ESC/POS 58mm/80mm printer and print text, receipts, QR codes, barcodes and images — fully offline, no login, no cloud.
features: Connect to ESC/POS Bluetooth thermal printers (58mm or 80mm)
Print free-form text with alignment, bold, underline and double size
Print professional receipts — items, quantities, prices, totals
Print QR codes — website, phone, email, UPI, WiFi, custom
Print barcodes — Code128, Code39, EAN13, UPC-A
Print images — crop, resize, black & white, Floyd–Steinberg dithering
Save favourite printers and auto-connect to the last one used
Material You design with light and dark mode
Fully offline — your data never leaves the device

notes: Real-device verification pass, fixed Print Image crashes
Play Store graphics and listing assets refreshed
Initial release with Bluetooth ESC/POS support
